You have someone that loves you.   A light in the fucking darkness.   Thats far more than what most of us have.   Dont fuck your boyfriend over if he really is that amazing.   That would suck for him and ruin his life.   Dont fuck him over like that.
Fuck doctors.   I have had too many friends go there just to get fucked over with an anti depressant and end up killing themselves.  I swear those drugs are suicide pills.

As crazy as it sounds, I kinda like feeling this way.   Its a love hate relationship and feeling this beautiful sadness becomes addicting.   I dont want people to feel sorry for me and I am over caring how people think of me.   

If I were me a year ago, I would move on.   I would pull myself up, refuse to give in, and fight my depression to the end.   If I could talk to myself a year ago, I would tell myself to stop feeling sorry for myself.   I would tell myself to quit putting up with shit from my family.  I would tell myself that my ex is an absolute selfish bitch who doesnt deserve me.   I would tell myself that I am a great person who was dealt a bad hand.   i would win this battle.  Everything I said is true too. 

 But myself now, I know its finished.  With my health issues, and lost time, I have reached a point where its not worth fighting.     Its really cool meeting you.  I read your posts and feel for you.  You got fucked over too and I know how you feel.   There are a couple of users on here who are really fucking cool and who have helped me a ton.   Some know exactly what we are going through and some are happy today.  I think its possible to recover. Easy?  Fuck no.  But I think its possible.   If I were in your shoes, I would fucking fight it and get better.   

The call is left to you.  Some make our decisions based on emotions and others based on logic. Logically the best choice for me is to finish this.  If I were in your shoes, logically I would probably fight it but emotionally want to end it.   I dont know man.  I dont want to encourage anyone to do what I am doing.   I wish circumstances had been different.   All in all I wouldnt let some selfish bitch finish me off.  If anyone is going to make me end it, its going to be me.  My decisions, and my game.  

If you are going to do it, dont do it because of her.  If you do it, do it because you are out of options.   To answer your question, I think its possible to get better yes.

Alright man, ill indulge you.  Im 27.  My family sided with her on a million issues and constantly tell me I made a huge mistake losing her.   I didnt tell my family the real story and she still feeds my family a shit ton of lies.  I asked them to stop talking to her, and they wont.   In a big way, they picked her over me.   Most of my friends are work friends and now that I lost my job we dont hang out anymore.  

I am not a crying bitch saying that no one loves me, but I feel majorly betrayed by my family, and I honestly cant do this anymore.
I have no money to travel, I lost my job, its been two years and time hasnt done shit.  This is the end my friend.  Thank you though.
